Name: Scythe Harvests More
Author: gzhynko
Description:
[b]Scythe Harvests More [/b]allows the iridium scythe to harvest more items like forage and machines. Currently harvesting from the following is supported, in addition to the default functionality:
[list]
[*]Machines
[*]Forage
[*]Fruit trees
[/list]Any of the above can be disabled through config.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Download this mod and extract into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility
[/size][list]
[*]Compatible with SMAPI 4.0.0 and higher (the latest version is recommended).
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 and higher.
[/list]

Scythe Harvests More is [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/ScytheHarvestsMore]open-source[/url]﻿﻿ and is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/LICENSE]0BSD License[/url]﻿.
